feeds.description: Dial Kashmir was created with the aim to facilitate communication processes within Kashmiri society. It provides a platform to Kashmiri businesses and service providers, and at the same time gives the local population a medium to get through to the businesses and services in times of need.

feeds.title: Naaz Kashmir Blog
feeds.description: A Kashmir travel blog by Naaz Kashmir. Well defined by its own tagline 'Comfort Lives Here', came into existence 40 years ago when a visit to Kashmir was known to be more of a life experience and staying on a floating Houseboat a novelty. Foundation was laid by M.S.Baktoo well known as King Sultan, for his love for nature, adventure and his favorite sports: Trout Fishing.
